2.6 Block Average - All HbO Channels

Grand average HRF across all trials for each fNIRS channel. Useful for identifying which channels show task-related hemodynamic responses.

Interpretation: Channels with clear positive deflection during task window (0 to task duration) indicate successful measurement of motor cortex activation.

✗ RECOMMENDATION: Validation failed. Major issues detected.
  Significant problems with:
  - EEG signal quality or task engagement
  - fNIRS optode coupling or hemodynamic response
  - Neurovascular coupling strength

  Recommend troubleshooting before proceeding.

Diagnostic Suggestions:
----------------------------------------------------------------------
• Alpha ERD not significant: Check C3 electrode placement,
  verify subject engaged in task, consider longer task duration
• Beta ERD not significant: Verify movement execution,
  check for excessive muscle artifacts
• HbO onset not detected: Check optode coupling (SCI),
  verify task timing, consider motion artifacts
• Plateau amplitude not significant: Check optode placement,
  verify task difficulty sufficient to elicit response
• Unexpected coupling lag: Verify temporal synchronization,
  check LSL timestamps, review event markers
• Weak coupling correlation: May indicate poor signal quality
  in either EEG or fNIRS, or weak task-related activation
